assumptions.description: For deterministic sequential modeling, mandatory phase-3 planting is scheduled active player first and then clockwise, while each player chooses their own card order.
assumptions.rationale: The rulebook requires all such cards to be planted and explicitly gives each person control of their order, but does not specify an order among people.
assumptions.impact: This fixes the evaluator-visible order of otherwise mandatory planting decisions without changing which cards must be planted.

assumptions.description: The ordinary legal-action list enumerates single-card gifts and one-for-one trades; the transition validator accepts all rulebook-legal unequal multi-card bundles supplied as canonical trade_propose actions.
assumptions.rationale: The source permits unequal quantities but gives no interface rule for enumerating exponentially many simultaneous proposals.
assumptions.impact: Canonical multi-card proposals remain accepted, while the routinely enumerated legal-action set stays finite and tractable.
